description: Create a company with a website domain, or set noWebsite and provide a name. Optionally provide a business description and create a four-email welcome sequence. Requires a personal account key (seq_user_...); company-scoped keys cannot create another workspace. Website creation queues brand processing and this tool polls for completion.

description.description: Optional business description (up to 500 characters). With a domain, website processing may replace it with the site's own description.

domain.description: Website domain (e.g., example.com). Required unless noWebsite is true.

name.description: Company name (optional, will be extracted from domain if not provided)

noWebsite.description: Set true to create without a website; requires name when domain is omitted.

websiteType.description: Company category, recorded as the user's choice. mobile_app is for iOS/Android apps (typically with RevenueCat, Superwall or Adapty): it recommends push-first mobile journeys from list_sequence_templates. Omit to let website processing detect it.

withWelcomeSequence.description: Set true to create and queue generation of a four-email welcome sequence. Defaults to false.

name: create_company

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_company` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

autoSelected.description: Whether the new company was selected for subsequent MCP calls.

company.description: The company record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.

welcomeAutomationId.description: Created welcome-sequence ID, or null when not requested or unavailable.

welcomeEnrichmentJobId.description: Queued generation job ID, or null when not requested or enqueue failed.
